info.description: Team-owned frontend contract. Default base /api/v1. UTC timestamps, decimal strings, opaque identifiers. Omit unavailable optional fields. Synthetic examples. All operations are scoped to the configured team.

get.description: UTC clock-hour by default. Counts refer to RFQs received in the window; gateway usage refers to calls charged in the window. Unavailable metrics are omitted.

parameters.description: Defaults to CURRENT_HOUR. EVENT starts at the first locally received RFQ.

get.description: SSE with event: change, id: global decimal sequence, data: one Event JSON. Comment heartbeat every 15 seconds. Last-Event-ID takes precedence over after. With neither, stream new events from connection time. Resume strictly after the cursor; delivery may repeat at reconnect boundaries. Expired cursor receives 410 before stream starts.
